inputs.text: An original stylized fantasy action-game encounter concept for Torch: Dominions in the Cinderwild at dusk. Hold the previous elevated three-quarter 2.5D camera, looking down approximately 35 degrees, and the same compact ruined-stone combat clearing, ash-slate path leading toward a broken sanctuary arch, foreground charred branches, slate blue-grey stone, muted moss, weathered bronze, cool dusk atmosphere, warm ember pinpoints, painterly gouache-like materials, anime-scale silhouette clarity, controlled warm/cool edge light and restrained environmental detail. At left-midground, one practical wayfarer in layered worn travel cloth, a single pale ash mantle and copper fasteners visibly grips one bespoke dark-ceramic perforated Haze lantern with violet glass vents. At right-midground, one disciplined ash rogue in contrasting muted ivory and weathered bronze armor is in a readable melee wind-up and visibly grips exactly one handheld rogue torch: a compact forged haft, hand-stop, and distinct burning metal cage/lantern head with ember light; it is unmistakably a ritual torch, not a firearm, bow, crossbow, rifle, pistol, wand, spear, or projectile weapon. No stock, trigger, sight, barrel, muzzle, gun-like silhouette, or ranged weapon. From the open vents of the wayfarer's violet lantern, Purple Haze has already spread outward into a broad, low, ground-hugging area-control cloud, flowing horizontally across a substantial half of the clearing and around the rogue's footing. Show an extended coverage footprint in top-visible ground-plane perspective, with rolling scalloped edges and several translucent layered density bands, including a contained amethyst hot core; it is a field-sized cloud, not a floating ball, small puff, detached projectile, vertical plume, or opaque screen fog. The route, both foot contacts, the hero's hand-to-lantern grip, the rogue's torch hand and its melee attack tell remain clearly legible through the smoke. Original authored fantasy-game composition, coherent value groups, tactile stone/cloth/ceramic/metal, no text, no UI, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no panels, no photorealism, no neon cyberpunk, no extra characters, no duplicate props, no other enemy weapons, no franchise references.
